watchme.trigger: each driven piece reaches a disposition — the driver's own result write is the event that already fires, and the comparison is read at the ticket's PROVED crossing. No poll: the driver records the hunks it applied, and the crossing that already happens is what closes the pair.
watchme.enough: five driven pieces with survival recorded — the same five the offload probe waits for, deliberately, so the two watches answer their different questions over ONE population rather than each demanding its own five real tickets
watchme.carrier: per driven piece: the edit as the apprentice applied it, versus the same files as they stand at the ticket's PROVED commit, dispositioned survived | rewritten | discarded. THIS IS THE QUESTION THE OFFLOAD PROBE CANNOT ANSWER: a ticket can pass its physics green while every line the apprentice wrote was thrown away and rewritten by CC — the offload buying nothing while reporting success. A green that was earned by the supervisor rather than the apprentice is a hollow green (Law 8), and nothing today would say so.
watchme.nexus: the hypothesize tree — the same nexus aider_shim_offload_yield deposits to, so the pair (did it pass / did the apprentice's work survive) lands beside the expectation it tests
watchme.consumer: Akien at triage — offload-more vs pull-back is his call, and this is the column that tells him whether a green was earned by the apprentice or by the hand cleaning up after it
